Whether to ask the owner, or to give H1 and the Low items to a rework step and a short re-read of REQ-069/077/078 under the same limit, is ORCH's decision; I do not include or exclude anything in the plan (WF-01, step 3).

Verified without trust: G1-G16 closed (table in g_closure); the literals of REQ-072 (S1 and chain.json) and the page values N = 6 against total = 5 are right by my own recomputation; the 26-step order and every depends_on target; the closed word lists and their counts on the real texts and on invented violations and look-alikes.

Not run because the code does not exist: all commands that check new code, new tests, new files (picker-words*, picker-theme*, picker-look*, picker-status-race, picker-result-page, picker-print, picker-csv, picker-board*, the stands, the board, the browser steps).

AP-018: the task named no expected verdict; the verdict is derived from the blocks. AP-023: the tag base/DESIGN0083-20261026-01 exists and was used as the before copy; the integrity of other blocks is my own comparison, not the author's hashes.

Author's notes of step 05 seen: I1 (theme button mount, see H12), I2 (the accepted edge N = 6 against 'Точность 3 из 5' is written as a literal in REQ-072, 074, 075), I3 (0084 section 1 aligned by ORCH, confirmed), I5 (owner BACKEND-DEV for a test-only requirement: not a defect), I6 (en accessible name, see H12).
Low findings H2-H13 go to a follow-up list; none blocks. If a rework step is ordered for H1, the cheap Low ones to take in the same edit are H3, H5, H6, H7, H10 and H13 (one sentence each).
